name: onboarding-api

dependencies.name: email-service
dependencies.description: Sends the daily overdue-task reminder email to the owning department.

description: Owns new hires, the standard checklist template, and every onboarding task. Instantiates a new hire's tasks from the template on creation, lets HR add one-off tasks and maintain the template, lets each department list and complete its own tasks, and runs the daily job that emails a reminder for every task still open past its due date. Does not send email itself — it calls the email service — and holds no UI.
